Please refer to the upgrade notes for more information.\n\nSpring AI provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for the Azure Ollama Embedding Model. ## Plan complete

**Branch**: `002-ticket-rag-assistant`  
**Feature directory**: `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant`  
**Plan**: `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/plan.md`

### Generated artifacts

| Artifact | Path |
|----------|------|
| Research (Spring AI 1.1.8, starters, properties with doc URLs) | `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/research.md` |
| Data model | `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/data-model.md` |
| API contract (OpenAPI) | `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/contracts/ai.openapi.yaml` |
| Quickstart | `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/quickstart.md` |
| Architecture (RAG pipeline, chunking, embeddings, prompt caching) | `specs/architecture.md` |
| Ingestion spec | `specs/rag-ingestion.md` |
| API contract (narrative) | `specs/rag-api-contract.md` |
| Evaluation strategy | `specs/evaluation-strategy.md` |
| Test strategy (AI section) | `specs/test-strategy.md` |

### Key technical decisions

- **Spring AI 1.1.8** on the 1.x line (not 2.x / Boot 4). Starters: `spring-ai-starter-vector-store-pgvector`, `spring-ai-starter-model-ollama`.
- **Ollama**: `nomic-embed-text` (768 dims), `llama3.1:8b` at temperature `0`.
- **Retrieval**: `app.rag.top-k=5`, `app.rag.similarity-threshold=0.6` (overrides spec assumption of 0.7 per your instruction).
- **Flyway V3** enables the `vector` extension; `spring.jpa.open-in-view=false`.
- **Ingestion**: `TicketDocumentMapper` + `TicketIndexer` (`@TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT)` + `@Async`, delete-then-add, startup backfill when empty).
- **Ask**: empty retrieval → no LLM; static system prompt; citation filter; `grounded=false` when nothing retrieved.
- **3 implementation slices**: ingestion + re-index → ask endpoint → Ask AI UI.

### Constitution check

All gates pass. No complexity-tracking violations.

### Next step

Ready for **`/speckit-tasks`** to generate `specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/tasks.md` from this plan.

 Update only specs/002-ticket-rag-assistant/{plan.md,research.md,data-model.md,quickstart.md,contracts/ai.openapi.yaml} and specs/{rag-ingestion.md,rag-api-contract.md,evaluation-strategy.md}:
1. Chunk text: every chunk's content starts with a header line "Ticket {ticketId} | {title} | status {status} | priority {priority} | category {category} | section {sourceType}" followed by the section text, so ID, title, status and priority are embedded and visible to the LLM. LLM context blocks use the same header.
2. nomic-embed-text: document whether to apply "search_document: " / "search_query: " prefixes (verify against the Ollama/nomic model card, cite the URL). Similarity threshold 0.6 is a starting value: log retrieval scores at DEBUG and calibrate it from the eval run; record the calibrated value and reasoning in evaluation-strategy.md.
3. Sources: built from retrieved chunks (deduplicated per ticketId, highest score), filtered to IDs cited in the answer. If the answer cites no retrieved ID, or cites an ID not retrieved, return grounded=false with the no-match answer instead of an unsupported answer. Unit tests for both cases.
4. Test isolation: concrete mechanism — `app.rag.indexing.enabled` (@ConditionalOnProperty on TicketIndexer and VectorStoreBackfill), false in backend/src/test/resources/application.yml; `@MockitoBean EmbeddingModel`/`ChatModel` where context needs them. Existing Phase 1 tests must pass with Ollama stopped.
5. Indexer: @Transactional(readOnly = true) when reloading ticket + comments; @EnableAsync configured.
